schema.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group: the VS-level identity asserted by the `ServiceCredential`. The group is `null` (not this object) when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

pattern.description: Architecture pattern (`Did.pattern`); non-null whenever a ServiceCredential exists.

description.description: `ServiceCredential.description`, optionally truncated for card use (truncation ends at a character boundary and is flagged with a trailing `…`).
